name: What should I wear and bring to an indoor cycling class?

mainEntity.name: What should I wear and bring to an indoor cycling class?

acceptedAnswer.text: For indoor cycling, wear comfortable, breathable athletic clothing that allows for a full range of motion. Padded cycling shorts can enhance comfort, especially for longer sessions. Stiff-soled athletic shoes are recommended; some bikes may accommodate cycling-specific shoes with SPD cleats. It's crucial to bring a water bottle to stay hydrated throughout the workout. Many participants also bring a small towel to manage sweat. At Cave Training, we recommend arriving a few minutes early for your first class so our team can help you properly set up your bike for optimal comfort and safety.
